intent: No NEW source file over 800 lines (God file). Existing oversized files are grandfathered by the ratchet; this blocks ADDING another. The featured tools/calibrate.ts and engine/types/config.ts are accepted at current size — decompose them on purpose, don't grow new ones.

PRIMARY function-health gate: no NEW function with cyclomatic complexity over 12 (1 + decision points + &&/||). The less-arbitrary signal than length — flags BRANCHY hard-to-test functions, not merely long ones (McCabe ~10; 12 is forgiving). Ratchet grandfathers today's complex functions and blocks any new one.

Coarse BACKSTOP: no NEW function over 150 lines. Complexity (above) is the primary gate; this only catches huge-but-flat functions complexity misses (long sequential builders, big literal/data tables). Set high so it doesn't flag clean ~100-line functions. Ratchet.
No NEW module imported by more than 12 files (coupling hub). engine/types is a type-contract barrel (benign) and is grandfathered; this blocks a NEW everything-depends-on-it module forming.

No test pinned to a frozen git ref/SHA (git diff <ref>..HEAD, --name-only, git show <sha>) — such tests can only rot as HEAD moves. Round/PR-scoped scope checks belong in a gate, not the permanent suite. (Library tenet L2; universal.)

Product code (engine/, tools/, test/) must not read process/working-state under coordination/ (removed from this repo; this guards against the fused product+process pattern re-forming). (Library tenet L1; per-project.)
